reasons: estimand-functional-replace: The estimand functional must record the newly proved conservative full-class upper bound while continuing to distinguish it from the open sharp exponent and the solved radial identity.
Add the radial modulus symbol and dependency, remove reliance on an unproved sharp full-class equality, and wire the proposition to the narrowed full-class theorem.

narrow: The full primary Morse class has a proved three-quarters lower exponent and a proved one-third upper exponent, while three-quarters is two-sided only on the radial restriction. Claiming the full-class three-quarters equality would still assume the unresolved rigidity step.
Replace the unsupported sharp inverse-rate dependency by the proved narrowed full-class modulus while retaining the established spectral law estimator.

narrow: The law estimator is uniformly certified at radius rho, but the three-quarters inverse exponent is not proved on the full model class. The proved weak full-class modulus propagates instead to exponent k divided by ((k+n/2)(m+1)), giving the honest primary rate one-twelfth.
Rewire the narrowed theorem from the unresolved sharp-rigidity question to the proved weak scalar finite-type rigidity lemma and the established lower construction.

narrow: The claimed sharp full-class upper bound requires the unresolved arbitrary-diffeomorphism incompressible-rigidity estimate. The proposed claim retains the proved sharp lower bound and adds the strongest full-class upper bound derivable from the frozen scalar finite-type ratios by interpolation, without substituting the radial subclass for the full class.
Retain the proved coverage result and rewire the diameter proof to the narrowed full-class modulus; the estimator theorem is not needed for this direct inversion argument.

narrow: Uniform coverage is proved, but the originally asserted sharp representation diameter requires the unresolved full-class modulus. The law-space triangle inequality combined with the proved weak full-class modulus gives the displayed slower, fully justified diameter.

verdict.note: Accept the honest metadata bracket and the sound weak-rigidity result. Reject the dependent theorem changes pending removal of the stray commas in all displayed exponents and restoration of prop:identification-hypothesis-comparison as the justification for exact zero-law quotient recovery; d_rep=0 alone does not prove quotient equivalence.
